unread_leads.why: KEY 9.4 T lead. Same subjects at 3, 7 and 9.4 T; T1 and T2* of brain tissue. Abstract has no tissue values ("T1 values increased, T2* decreased"). No PMC copy; Wiley HTML returns 403 to tools and the browser page shows the abstract only (full text is PDF only).
9.4 T whole-brain MP2RAGE T1 mapping (25 subjects) and multi-echo T2 mapping. No values in abstract; closed access.
TESS T2 maps of human brain at 3, 7 and 9.4 T. No values in abstract; closed access.

unread_leads.why: T2* maps of human brain at 9.4 T. No values in abstract; no PMC copy.
R1 and R2* maps of midbrain at 9.4 T in 14 healthy volunteers. No values in abstract; closed access.

unread_leads.citation: Rooney et al. Magn Reson Med 2007;57:308-18
unread_leads.why: T1 of many brain tissues at 0.2, 1.0, 1.5, 4.0 and 7.0 T. Abstract gives only power-law fits (WM T1(s)=0.583(B0)^0.382, internal GM 0.857(B0)^0.376, blood 1.35(B0)^0.340) and "The ventricular cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) 1H2O T1 value did not change with B0, and its average value (standard deviation (SD)) across subjects and magnetic fields was 4.3 (+/-0.2) s." The CSF value is an average across fields, so it was not put in a record. Per-field table is in the full text (Wiley, PDF only, not read). No values were calculated from the fits.
